artifact.title: Incident Response Foundations workplace project rubric

criteria.exemplary: Defines authorization, assets, assumptions, constraints, and success criteria precisely.
criteria.meets: Defines the main scope and assumptions with minor gaps that do not invalidate the work.

criteria.exemplary: Uses traceable evidence, considers alternatives, and clearly separates observation from inference.
criteria.meets: Uses relevant evidence and provides a defensible reasoning chain.

criteria.exemplary: Proposes bounded remediation, validates outcome and side effects, and records residual risk.
criteria.meets: Proposes a proportionate action and verifies the intended result.

criteria.exemplary: Produces a concise, reproducible report suited to technical and business stakeholders.
criteria.meets: Communicates the decision, evidence, outcome, and limitations clearly.

artifact.passingRule: Meet or exceed every criterion with a total score of at least 70%.
